Lake County COAD Community Resilience Centers

This map shows community resilience centers in Lake County that are part of the Community Organizations Active in Disaster (COAD) network. These sites provide shelter, cooling, and resources during extreme heat events and other emergencies.

For county emergency preparedness resources, visit the Lake County Office of Climate Resiliency.

Map maintained by Tracking California in partnership with Lake County COAD and the Lake County Office of Climate Resiliency. To report updates or corrections, contact scarlet.sandsbliss@trackingcalifornia.org.
